levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: Harthama tells his own encounter in the Ma'mun's house; the Imam speaks inside it («فقال لي عليه السلام: يا هرثمة»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
«يعني الرضا» is the report's gloss on the Imam, left out; the Ma'mun, Sabih and the boys are in the scene, not links.
